english.note: Use this for the capacity of a person, organism, or thing to live, survive, and develop.

examples.english: This old banyan tree has strong vitality and is still growing vigorously after so many years of wind and rain.
examples.traditional: 呢棵老榕樹生命力好強，俾風吹雨打咁多年都仲生得好旺。
